source: due2-native: a binding whose range is of another kind than the property it reads (decisions/0014)
notes: The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl; the rejection is due2's. Without the check, every value of due2:actionTime, an xsd:dateTime, would fail the range xsd:date, so every evaluation of ex:display would be U: an authoring error found only at request time. A policy that means the calendar date of the action compares the dateTime with an instant, such as 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z with lt, which also names the time zone the date lacks.

expected_rejection.why: ex:useDate reads due2:actionTime, whose rdfs:range is xsd:dateTime, but its own range is xsd:date. A date and a dateTime are different kinds (due2-profiles.md §3), so W1 rejects the policy in stage 2 (decisions/0014 #5).
